items.q: BiblioFuse Reader 可以打开哪些文件？
items.a: BiblioFuse Reader 在同一个书库中管理漫画、日漫、PDF、EPUB 和 TXT，包括从你自己的 Mac 或 PC 串流的大型混合收藏。所有处理都在你的设备上完成：无需上传、无需账号，也不会追踪你读了什么。

items.q: 我的文件会上传到 BiblioFuse 服务器吗？
items.a: 不会。应用以本机处理为核心。阅读、压缩、重复扫描和网页工具都在本地处理文件。同步和串流使用你自己的 iCloud、本地网络或 Tailscale，而不是 BiblioFuse 账户。
大多数 BiblioFuse 应用可以免费试用或有免费限制，重度使用可选择付费升级。各平台商店页面会显示当前价格。

items.q: 一次购买是否涵盖所有平台？
items.a: 不是。iOS + Mac 属于同一次通用购买——付一次即可用于 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和 Apple Vision Pro。Android 版 Reader、PC 版 Reader 和 PC 工具需分别购买。

faq.q: SmartDecrypt 支持哪些文件格式？
faq.a: PDF、ZIP 和 7z。未加密的 ZIP 和 7z 压缩文件会自动提取，无需输入密码。SmartDecrypt 目前不支持 RAR、EPUB 或其他格式。

faq.q: SmartDecrypt 能破解未知密码吗？
faq.a: 不能。SmartDecrypt 为您已有权访问的文件而设计。它使用您已保存在配置文件中的密码——它不会破解或暴力破解未知密码。

faq.q: 我的密码安全吗？
faq.a: 是的。密码仅存储在您设备上的系统钥匙串中——与 Safari 和其他应用使用的安全存储相同。SmartDecrypt 永不在其自己的数据库中存储密码，任何内容都不会上传到任何服务器。

faq.q: 什么是文件名模式？
faq.a: 文件名模式是用于识别重复文件的部分名称或关键词。例如，如果您的银行发送命名为 'BankStatement_2024-01.pdf' 的月度对账单，请创建一个模式为 'BankStatement' 和相应密码的配置文件。SmartDecrypt 将自动将未来的文件匹配到该配置文件。

faq.q: Pro 购买在 iPhone 和 Mac 之间共享吗？
faq.a: 是的。SmartDecrypt Pro 是一次性通用购买。在 iOS 或 macOS 中的任一平台购买一次，使用相同的 Apple ID 在两个平台上解锁专业版。

faq.q: ContentCue 适用于哪些网站？

faq.q: 位置恢复如何工作？
faq.a: ContentCue 在你阅读时监控你的滚动位置。当你离开页面时（点击广告链接、重定向或返回按钮），它会保存你的精确位置。浏览器 UI 中会出现恢复按钮。点击它可以返回到你所在的确切位置。

faq.q: 我可以在 ContentCue 中收听播客吗？

faq.q: ContentCue 会朗读网页内容吗？

faq.q: ContentCue 能在 iPhone、iPad 和 Vision Pro 之间同步吗？

faq.q: ContentCue 支持 Apple Vision Pro 吗？

faq.q: ContentCue 支持 CarPlay 吗？
faq.a: 支持。ContentCue 会出现在车辆的 CarPlay 屏幕上，显示已保存的播客和 RSS 订阅。你可以直接在车载屏幕上开始播放、查看当前队列、调整播放速度。

faq.q: ContentCue 会收集我的浏览数据吗？

toolsPages.appPitch: BiblioFuse reads CBZ, CBR, EPUB, PDF and TXT on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and Windows — and streams big libraries straight from your own machine.

cbz-reducer.cardDesc: Shrink comic archives by re-encoding the pages inside, without splitting the volume.
cbz-reducer.seoTitle: Reduce CBZ File Size — Free, In Your Browser, No Upload
cbz-reducer.seoDesc: Compress CBZ and ZIP comic archives in your browser. Re-encodes the pages inside at a resolution and quality you choose. Nothing is uploaded — the whole job runs on your device.
cbz-reducer.intro: Drop in a CBZ or ZIP and it re-encodes every page inside at the size and quality you pick, then hands the archive back. Large scans usually lose most of their weight with no visible difference on a phone screen.

sections.title: Why comic archives get so big
sections.body: A CBZ is just a ZIP full of page images. Scans are often stored at print resolution — 3000px wide or more — which is far beyond what any phone or tablet can display. Re-encoding those pages to the resolution you actually read at is usually where the savings come from, not the archive format.

sections.title: What the settings do
sections.body: Shortest-dimension resolution caps the smaller side of each page, so tall pages and spreads scale consistently. Quality controls the encoder. Grayscale drops colour channels entirely, which helps a lot on black-and-white manga and nothing at all on colour comics.

sections.title: Nothing leaves your device
sections.body: The archive is opened, re-encoded and rebuilt inside your browser using WebAssembly. There is no upload step, no queue and no server that ever sees the file — which also means it works on files you would not want to hand to a web service.

faq.q: Will this ruin the image quality?
faq.a: Only if you tell it to. The default settings target the resolution a phone or tablet actually renders at, which is well below what most scans are stored at, so the visible result is usually identical. If you archive at print quality, raise the resolution cap or leave the file alone.

faq.q: Does it work on CBR or RAR files?
faq.a: No — CBR is a RAR archive, and RAR cannot be opened in the browser for licensing reasons. Convert to CBZ first, or use the BiblioFuse app, which reads CBR directly.

faq.q: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a: The limit is your device's memory, not a server quota, because the work happens locally. Very large volumes are fine on a desktop; a phone with several hundred megabytes of pages may run out of room.

epub-reducer.cardDesc: Re-encode the images inside an EPUB so it syncs and stores smaller.
epub-reducer.seoTitle: Compress EPUB Files — Free, In Your Browser, No Upload
epub-reducer.seoDesc: Shrink EPUB files by re-encoding the images inside them, in your browser. Text and structure are left untouched. No upload, no account, nothing sent to a server.
epub-reducer.intro: Drop in an EPUB and it re-encodes the images inside — covers, illustrations, embedded scans — while leaving the text, structure and metadata exactly as they were.

sections.title: It is almost always the images
sections.body: The text in a novel-length EPUB is tiny — often under a megabyte. When an EPUB is large, it is because of embedded images stored at far higher resolution than any reader will display. Re-encoding those is where the size goes.

sections.title: What is left alone
sections.body: Chapter structure, table of contents, metadata and the text itself are untouched — they are copied through unchanged. Only the image files inside the archive are re-encoded, so the book opens and navigates exactly as before.

sections.title: Nothing leaves your device
sections.body: The EPUB is unpacked, processed and repacked inside your browser. No copy is uploaded, which matters for books you own but would rather not hand to a web service.

faq.q: Will it break DRM-protected books?
faq.a: It cannot open them at all. DRM-protected EPUBs are encrypted, so there is nothing to re-encode. This works on DRM-free files only.

faq.q: Does the text get compressed too?
faq.a: No. Text is copied through untouched — it is a negligible share of the file size and re-encoding it would risk breaking the book's structure for no gain.

faq.q: Will my reader still open it?
faq.a: Yes. The output is a standard EPUB with the same structure and metadata as the input; only the image files inside are smaller.

pdf-to-cbz.cardDesc: Turn a PDF comic into a CBZ so comic readers can page through it properly.
pdf-to-cbz.seoTitle: Convert PDF to CBZ — Free, In Your Browser, No Upload
pdf-to-cbz.seoDesc: Convert PDF comics and scans to CBZ in your browser. Each page is rendered to an image and packed into a comic archive. No upload, no account, nothing sent to a server.
pdf-to-cbz.intro: Drop in a PDF and every page is rendered to an image and packed into a CBZ, so comic readers can treat it as a proper page-by-page volume instead of a document.

sections.title: Why convert at all
sections.body: PDF is a document format. Comic readers built around CBZ get page-spread detection, reading direction, thumbnail grids and per-page bookmarks — features a PDF viewer generally does not offer for scanned comics.

sections.title: What you get out
sections.body: A standard CBZ: a ZIP of sequentially numbered page images. Pages are rendered at 2× scale so text and line art stay sharp when you zoom, then encoded to a web-friendly format.

sections.title: Nothing leaves your device
sections.body: Rendering and packing both happen in your browser. The PDF is never uploaded, so this is safe to use on scans and documents you would not want to put through a web service.

faq.q: Does the text stay searchable?
faq.a: No. CBZ is an image format by definition, so any selectable text in the PDF becomes part of the page image. If you need text search, keep the PDF — or read it in BiblioFuse, which can OCR pages on device.

faq.q: What resolution are the pages rendered at?
faq.a: 2× the PDF's native page size, which keeps line art and lettering sharp when zoomed. Larger PDFs therefore take longer and use more memory.

faq.q: Can it convert back the other way?
faq.a: Not here — this direction covers the common case of a PDF that ought to be a comic. The BiblioFuse app handles CBZ to PDF on device.

pdf-to-jpg.cardDesc: Export every page of a PDF as an image, downloaded as a ZIP.
pdf-to-jpg.seoTitle: Convert PDF to JPG — Free, In Your Browser, No Upload
pdf-to-jpg.seoDesc: Export PDF pages as JPG images in your browser and download them as a ZIP. Pick the render quality. No upload, no account, nothing sent to a server.
pdf-to-jpg.intro: Drop in a PDF and every page is rendered to a JPG at the quality you choose, then bundled into a single ZIP download.

sections.title: What it is for
sections.body: Pulling pages out as images — for a slide, a reference sheet, an issue report, or any workflow that wants pictures rather than a document. Every page is exported; there is no per-page selection step.

sections.title: Choosing quality
sections.body: The quality control is the render scale, not just the encoder setting. Higher values render each page larger before encoding, which keeps small text legible at the cost of file size and processing time.

sections.title: Nothing leaves your device
sections.body: Rendering uses the PDF engine built into the page and runs entirely in your browser. The file is never uploaded — which is the point if the PDF is a statement, a contract, or anything else you would not paste into a web tool.

faq.q: Can I export just one page?
faq.a: Not currently — every page is exported and delivered as a ZIP. Extract the one you need from the archive.

faq.q: Why JPG and not PNG?
faq.a: JPG is dramatically smaller for scanned and photographic pages, which is the common case. For line art or screenshots where you want lossless output, PDF to CBZ preserves more detail.

faq.q: Does it work on password-protected PDFs?
faq.a: No. An encrypted PDF has to be unlocked before anything can render it. SmartDecrypt, a separate app from the same studio, handles that case.

qr-generator.cardDesc: Make a setup QR code so the app can connect to your server without typing.
qr-generator.seoTitle: Kavita & Komga Setup QR Code Generator
qr-generator.seoDesc: Generate a QR code that points BiblioFuse at your Kavita or Komga server, so you do not have to type a URL and API key on a phone. Built in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.
qr-generator.intro: Fill in your server details and get a QR code the app can scan — no typing a long URL and API key on a phone keyboard.

sections.title: Why a QR code
sections.body: A self-hosted server address plus an API key is a long, error-prone thing to type on a phone. Scanning a code gets both across in one step, correctly, every time.

sections.title: Your key never leaves the page
sections.body: The code is drawn in your browser from the values you type. Nothing is submitted, logged or stored — close the tab and it is gone. The generated image is only as private as wherever you choose to put it, so treat a printed code like the API key it contains.

faq.q: Is my API key sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The QR code is generated locally in the page and the values you type are never transmitted or saved. Do bear in mind the finished code contains your key, so anyone who can photograph it can use it.

faq.q: Which servers does this support?
faq.a: Kavita and Komga. Pick the service type and the default port fills in; adjust the address if your setup differs.

items.q: Mac 或 PC 向 iPhone 的串流是如何工作的？
items.a: 您的 Mac 或 PC 运行本地服务器，并将连接地址写入 iCloud Drive。iPhone 会自动识别。两台设备必须同时开启 Tailscale（在家和远程均可使用）。如果只有一台设备开启了 Tailscale，连接将失败。保持两台设备始终开启 Tailscale 可获得最稳定的体验。

items.q: 设置串流需要准备什么？
items.a: 这取决于你想在哪里阅读。

sub: Mac 或 PC 上的主机应用会在局域网中广播自己，iPhone、iPad 或 Vision Pro 会自动找到它。
应用第一次询问时允许访问本地网络即可，这就是全部设置。

bullets.text: 离家在外：两台设备使用同一个 iCloud 账户，并且都运行 Tailscale。
sub: 主机会把地址写入你的 iCloud 云盘，阅读设备再通过 Tailscale 取用。
Windows 不内置 iCloud——请从 Microsoft Store 安装 Windows 版 iCloud。
iCloud 与 Tailscale 账户可以使用不同邮箱，也不需要启用 Tailscale 出口节点。

bullets.text: NAS 主机的方式不同——它完全没有 iCloud 通道。
sub: 先在局域网内配对一次以保存证书，之后同一台主机即可通过 Tailscale 远程访问。

items.q: 串流设置正确但主机不出现，可以怎么排查？
items.a: 过去常见的原因是地址文件过期。现在每次串流启动、停止或地址变化时，Mac 主机都会自行清除这些文件，包括 iCloud 冲突副本，所以这已经很少是问题所在。

bullets.text: 在主机上退出并重新打开应用。启动时它会发布新的地址。
在阅读设备上打开串流来源列表，查看主机名称旁是否有绿点。
sub: 灰色表示尚未连上主机——请等几秒，或在主机上强制退出并重新打开应用。

bullets.text: Windows 主机尚未支持这项自动清理。
sub: 如果 PC 主机始终不可见，请用 iPhone 或 Mac 打开 iCloud 云盘 → BiblioFuse → Documents，删除 stream_endpoint.json 以及任何带编号的副本，然后重新打开主机应用。
请用 iPhone 或 Mac 操作，而不要用这台 PC：Windows 可能只保留文件的在线版本，在那里删除并不可靠。

items.q: 在家串流需要 Tailscale 吗？
items.a: 不需要。局域网 Wi-Fi 串流可以独立工作：主机在你的网络中广播自己，应用通过带证书固定的 HTTPS 连接它。早期版本在局域网下确实失败过，原因是应用没有读取主机广播的元数据，退回到了正式版会拦截的普通 HTTP 地址。这个问题已修复。Tailscale 现在只用于离家阅读。

bullets.text: 「设置 → Mac / PC 串流」提供三种模式。
sub: iCloud + Tailscale——同时列出局域网主机和通过 iCloud 发布的远程主机。
局域网 Wi-Fi——只显示局域网主机，绝不显示或连接远程地址。
手动 Tailscale——用于手动输入的主机，包括 NAS。

bullets.text: 本地与远程之间刻意不做自动切换。
sub: 在同一网络中，同一台主机会同时出现两条记录，由你自行选择，因此可用的本地连接绝不会被悄悄换成更慢的线路。

bullets.text: Apple TV 仅支持局域网。
sub: tvOS 无法使用 iCloud 云盘，Tailscale 通道虽已开发并测试完成，但在 tvOS 上的 Tailscale 缺陷解决之前仍以关闭状态发布。

items.q: Android 能从 Mac 或 PC 主机读取吗？
items.a: 可以。Android 应用会在局域网中查找主机；主机在局域网配对一次之后，也可以通过手动输入地址来连接。它可以把书从主机复制到自己的书库，阅读进度、评分与标签都会回传给主机。Android 无法访问 iCloud，因此离家阅读需要通过 Tailscale 手动输入主机地址，而不是自动发现。

items.q: BiblioFuse 能在 Apple Vision Pro 上使用吗？
items.a: 可以。BiblioFuse 是 App Store 上的原生 visionOS 应用——一个真正的空间窗口，而非兼容模式下的 iPad 应用。它支持眼动追踪、捏合、鼠标、触控板和键盘，并已包含在 iOS + Mac 通用购买中，无需额外付费。

items.q: BiblioFuse 在 visionOS 上支持哪些空间阅读布局？
items.a: 三种空间图书馆布局：空间书架（封面陈列在悬浮书架上）、网格视图（面向大型图书馆的悬浮网格）和倾斜墙面（带评分和标签筛选的倾斜画廊墙面）。你还可以从 Mac 或 PC 串流图书馆，让 Vision Pro 的存储空间保持空闲。

items.q: 如何在 BiblioFuse 中获得更好的文字转语音声音？
items.a: 更高质量的声音已内置于您的设备中，但需要单独下载 — 安装后 BiblioFuse 将自动识别它们。

sub: 前往「设置」→「辅助功能」→「朗读内容」→「声音」
选择您的语言，然后下载「增强型」或「高级」声音
iOS 16+ 上的高级声音具有神经网络质量（Siri 级别）
前往「系统设置」→「辅助功能」→「朗读内容」→「系统声音」→「管理声音」
为您的语言下载任意「增强型」或「高级」声音
前往「设置」→「时间和语言」→「语言和区域」
添加您的阅读语言，或打开已安装语言的语言选项
在「语言功能」下，安装「文字转语音」
重启 BiblioFuse，然后开始新的 TTS 会话
前往「设置」→「辅助功能」→「讲述人」
在「添加自然语音」下，下载所需语音
注意：Windows 可能仅向讲述人开放这些语音，而非所有应用

bullets.text: 无需更新应用 — BiblioFuse 会在 Windows 或 Apple 文字转语音系统公开新安装的语音时自动检测
